items.title: Lucky Block Infinity
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
Explore an infinitely generating world of skyblock lucky block islands. With infinite generation, new lucky blocks will appear as you traverse the void!
- 6 rarities
- 41 unique structures
- 200+ outcomes
- Bonus Nether and End islands
- Challenging

items.title: Hoodie Teens
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Ready to show off your best hoodies?

- 22 amazing skins (1 free skin!)
- Perfect for role-playing
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Overtales Studio

items.title: Dress Up
items.creator: PixelHeads
items.description:
Dress Up is the ultimate clothing simulator with all wearables you can imagine. Browse millions of clothing combinations or wear one of the premade costumes. Take off wearing a fun helicopter hat, or blast off into the sunset with the cool rocket shoes!

- Millions of clothing and hairstyle combinations!
- Costumes with special powers!
- Express yourself with emojis!

items.title: Speedrunning
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description:
Test your limits and luck with this all in one speedrunning gamemode! Start from scratch from a variety of spawn options and race against the clock to slay the ender dragon and complete the game! With timing and milestone tracking built-in, all you need to do is play! Will you break the world record?

Multiple speedrunning areas!
Custom tracking and timing!

items.title: Space Heroes
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: In space, no one can hear you squeal. Go into the distant future and explore the galaxy with these space hero skins!

items.title: Criminals
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Time to escape in style!
Whether you're robbing a bank, pickpocketing, or stealing something, this pack will get you ready. Watch out, the police are on their way!

+ 7 scary criminals
+ Perfect pack for a RP with friends!
+ 1 FREE skin: Bandit!

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Treasure Defender
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Can you battle your way and escort the treasure along the path to safety while defeating swarms of angry mobs? Don't forget to protect the bank, level up, unlock specialty items and defend the prized treasure!
* Multiple shops!
* Special content!
* Unlimited play!
By Giggle Block Studios!

items.title: Waterfall Base
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Waterfall Base has everything you need for PVP and survival. Multiple bedrooms, armories, and farms at your ease. Take the staircase up and explore all the different rooms! We are sure to increase your fun with this waterfall base!

items.title: Anime School Kids
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
High school has started, choose your outfit and join your friends. Play as whomever you want to be and enjoy the school roleplay experience.

+ Teen fashion
+ Anime style
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Ninja Heroes 2
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
The second wave of friends of powerful ninjas and shinobi have gathered for you. As their buddies already in the game, these brave warriors decided to join them. They are still students and on a path to learn their art and is it up to you who will be the master among them!

+ Shinobi
+ Ninjas
+ Anime
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Fashion 2077
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
What will future fashion look like? It'll look like these skins! Go far beyond modern fashion and bring in the look of tomorrow! It's up to you!

+ Futuristic teen fashion
+ Cyberpunk
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Anime Roleplay
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Anime Roleplay skin pack includes 8 anime themed skins. You can use these skins to roleplay an anime story with your friends!

By: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: ANIME GALAXY
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Do you love anime? Do you love space travel? ANIME GALAXY is perfect for you! These skins are out of this world!

- Great for roleplaying
- Fun for everyone

items.title: GAMERS!
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Are you a gamer? Time to show the world you are a pro gamer with this epic skin pack! Time to level up.

By: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: The Elderly
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description: Have you ever felt like you're more mature than all your friends? Introducing The Elderly skin pack. Made for those who are wise beyond their years show off to your friends that you're just THAT much more experienced than them. Equip these skins for a unique fun twist to Minecraft skins sure to grab attention and make your friends laugh.

items.title: Learn to Build: Modern
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description:
Are you ready to bring your building skills to the next level? Well, grab your notebook and pencil because Learn to Builds: Modern is here! In this episode, Rob will walk you through how to make some of the coolest modern builds in an easy-to-follow, hands-on method you're sure to love.

~Become a building pro 
~Singleplayer or multiplayer
~By Entity Builds

items.title: High School Life
items.creator: Pixelbiester
items.description:
High school awaits you! Take the iconic school bus for your first day at school. Decorate the colossal world with modifiable furniture. Compete in the javelin throw or make an idyllic weekend foray. Be the smartest student and create a legendary high school party. 

+ Moveable and dyeable furnishing
+ Lots of rideable vehicles
+ 14 skins (2 free skins)
+ Special textures

items.title: Prison Escape
items.creator: Everbloom Games
items.description:
A unique stealth game in Minecraft! You play as Danny, having been tasked with breaking the Redstone Baron out of prison. Sneak past the guards in this epic prison escape! There's more to it than meets the eye...
* Advanced stealth mechanics in Minecraft
* Highly produced adventure map
* A compelling story with full voiceover!
- SINGLEPLAYER ONLY

items.title: Summer Fashion 2021
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Summer is here! It's time to show off your trendy fashion clothing to your friends. Be the coolest summer teen out there and look the part along with your buddies!

- 100% TRENDY
- 8 skins included
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from UniDesigns

items.title: The Badger Pack
items.creator: Geeky Pixels
items.description:
Whether you're a Bad Badger, or a Super Badger, there will be a badger for you in The Badger Pack! Which will you become?

- 14 skins

items.title: PJs and Bedtime
items.creator: Geeky Pixels
items.description:
Eyelids heavy? Struggling to stay away? Been up gaming waaaaaaay too long? Yeah, it's definitely time to set that spawn point with PJs and Bedtime!

- 11 unique pyjama and bed set skins
- 22 skins total
- A good night sleep not included

items.title: Wild Savanna
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Venift LLC presents: Wild Savanna! Immerse yourself in a land of beautiful animals! Explore a huge savanna world filled with animals and, of course, lots and lots of fun!

- Includes custom animals
- A massive custom world
- Licensed by Venift LLC and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Geeky's Mobs
items.creator: Geeky Pixels
items.description:
Aggressive, dangerous and sometimes downright vicious, mobs like to cause you a heap of trouble. They explode, teleport, steal, hack, slash and burn their way through your worlds and builds. Well it's time to take back some power; equip one of these skins to blur into their world of chaos.

- 23 mob skins
- Ability to explode, teleport or burn not included

items.title: Rich Mansions
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Live in a mansion! Live the life of tropical luxury!

+ 4 rich mansion islands!
+ By Nitric Concepts
